source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の追加 36 枚 (シート 80〜83、ユーザーが別に生成した画像)。案内と安全
style: Everyday details of a bright, lived-in space-habitat city in a Japanese style. PICTURE cells: ONE item or scene seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text or logos. CUTOUT-style PICTURE cells say "on plain pure white background": draw only the object, centred, on flat pure white with no shadow. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.

cells.name: mg-guide-lines
cells.prompt: Grey floor with painted colour guide lines (red, blue, green) running side by side, from above.

cells.name: mg-tactile-tiles
cells.prompt: Yellow tactile paving tiles with raised dots and bars, from above.

cells.name: mg-route-map
cells.prompt: A transit route map: coloured lines with circles for stops on white, no text.

cells.name: mg-fire-door
cells.prompt: A green steel fire door with a push bar and a small window, front-on.

cells.name: mg-fire-alarm
cells.prompt: A red fire alarm panel with a round button and a bell, on a wall, front-on, no text.

cells.name: mg-post-box
cells.prompt: A red Japanese street post box, front-on. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: mg-tree-grate
cells.prompt: A cast iron tree grate around a small tree trunk, seen from directly above.
cells.why: 幹が斜めに描かれていて、床に貼ると幹が寝て見える

cells.name: mg-drinking-fountain
cells.prompt: A stainless public drinking fountain on a post. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: mg-elevator-hall
cells.prompt: An elevator hall: two steel elevator doors with call buttons between them, front-on.
cells.why: 床と天井ごとの風景で、物の面に貼れない (エレベーターは既存の mg-elevator がある)
